rows.en:
Mm…

I hope so…

…!?
Heh heh heh… Like moths to a flame, that's exactly what this is!

…!?

You…?

Who on earth are you?

Ah, that's right… I haven't introduced myself, have I…

I am… a top commander of the great worldwide crime organization Shadow, the Knight of Shadows, Shadow Knight!

The two of you together…

…!?

What!? That flute?

You're…

Waruder!?
This humble one is Waruder indeed… and who might you be, good sir, who knows of me?

So you are Waruder? I've heard about you from Big Shadow.

Waruder!! The one you're to kill is right here!! That one!! It's Zero-One!
(He's strong…)
(This one may be even stronger than us…)
Do it, do it!! Now's your chance, Waruder!! Kill Zero-One before he can change!
(He hasn't left a single opening…)
(I can't change in front of him…)
What's wrong!? Waruder? Do it!!

This humble one has yet to be granted an audience with Lord Big Shadow. I am but a lowly wanderer…

Free to go as I please, I have no business with you gentlemen… Farewell.

Grr… Insolent wretch!

Kikaider, Zero-One! We'll call this match a draw for now! Toooh!!

Waruder…

He's good…
Oh ho… So, Waruder, you'll take up my request?
Now that I have accepted payment…
Hmph… Pretentious bastard!
Waruder, can you defeat them? Those two?
A simple matter…

Hmph… That's rich, coming from a coward who just tucked his tail and ran!

What's with that look? All right… I'll test your skill myself first! Come on!

Sir Shadow Knight, was it…

However much you or I may strain, we are in the end only machines that were made. To quarrel would be foolish…

Ha ha ha… So that's why you can't fight them either? You've given yourself away!

I won't lose to the likes of you!! I could take you down right here!
Then, Lord Big Shadow… this humble one shall take his leave for today…
Running away, Waruder!?

Wait, Waruder!!

Doesn't what Shadow Knight said make you angry?
This humble one is but a hired killer by trade. I cannot be bothered by the howling of a scrawny cur!
Scrawny cur!? I've let you run your mouth long enough…

I see…

Then, Waruder!! What if I were to ask you myself… to duel Shadow Knight?
It cannot be helped. Needless killing is not my wish, but…
Heh heh heh… I like you, Waruder!! Ha ha ha ha…

Whatever it takes, I want to save Mari from the path of evil!

If only the Conscience Circuit I gave her were complete…
Mm… For that, we have to rescue Dr. Komyoji too…
Ichiro, Jiro…
Mari!!
Ichiro, Jiro… Look over there.
That is DARK's secret base… Dr. Komyoji is inside.
What!? The doctor is in there?
Mari… Why are you telling us this?

I…

I…
Ha ha ha… You lot are too soft, I can't stand to watch!
Hakaider!?

Heh heh heh… I'll teach you what a real fight is!

First your arms and legs… next your heart, and finally your head!

Ha ha ha ha… Move even one millimeter! And consider your lives forfeit!
Change, Bijinder! Toh!!

Uoh…

You're Bijinder!?

Hakaider, think about it. You said you'd kill us!

Then suppose you did manage to destroy us. What would you do then?

Defeat Kikaider! Once you've achieved that goal, how will you go on living?

How I'll live after destroying Kikaider?

…I don't know, I've never thought about it! No, I don't even want to think about it!! Bah… shut up!! Mind your own business! Here I come!!
If you don't want to fight, then stay still! I'll tear your body to pieces!
Damn… Am I… losing!? Me…!!
Damn!! Hakaider…!
Damn!! Hakaider…!
Dr. Komyoji's brain…!? How could this happen…
Dr. Komyoji's brain…!? How could this happen…

I knew it… I'm an incomplete android!

A cold, cruel, evil android…

I'm an incomplete android born of Shadow.

No, that's not true! That's not it, Bijinder!! The you of a moment ago is the real you!

Bijindeeer!!

Volunteers of the DARK Destruction Squad…

Awaken! You are reborn with three times your former power!

You are no longer… who you were before! You must feel three times the power surging through your bodies…

Go, New DARK Destruction Squad! Kill Kikaider and Zero-One… and Hakaider too! Kiiill them!!
What am I? What am I!? Once I've defeated Kikaider… what will I live for?
Hakaider, stop! I can't fight you! Stop it!
Hakaider, stop! I can't fight you! Stop it!

What is my purpose? Why was I born?

Ahh, I hate it!! I hate Gill, who created me! I'll kill him!! I'll kill Professor Gill!!
Wait, Hakaider!! Where are you going!?
Wait, Hakaider!! Where are you going!?
I hate the one who made me! Professor Gill, I'll kill you!
Wh-what's going on? Hakaider, don't do anything rash!
Why? Why did you create me!? I'll kill you!!

D-don't get it wrong!! I'm not the one who made you! Komyoji…

It was Dr. Komyoji! If you want to kill your creator, kill Komyoji!!

Komyoji… That's no lie?

I'll kill him! I'll kill Komyoji!

Go ahead and kill him!

Go ahead and kill… Komyoji!!

If you kill Komyoji… your brain dies too!

And at the same time, your abilities will fall below those of an Androidman! Ha ha… Ahahahaha!!

Listen… You are the last warrior of the DARK Destruction Squad!

If you kill Kikaider and Zero-One… and Hakaider too, DARK can rise once more!

Kill, kill!! Kill, kill them all!! Kill Kikaider and Zero-One… and Hakaider too!
I heard the story from Mari! Is Dr. Komyoji safe?
I heard the story from Mari… Is Dr. Komyoji safe?
The doctor is inside DARK's base! I'll smash the New DARK Destruction Squad! Everyone, hurry to the base!!
The doctor is inside DARK's base! I'll smash the New DARK Destruction Squad! Everyone, hurry to the base!!
Right, understood. Leave the doctor's surgery to us!
But… if we don't hurry, it'll be too late!
Wait!! What about Hakaider? Unless we defeat him, the doctor's brain won't be restored!
He's headed to DARK's base to take revenge on Professor Gill!! If we don't hurry, the doctor's in danger too!!

uncertain: U08182/U08183: narration-kind row continues Shadow Knight's line (interrupted by Waruder's flute).
U08186 etc.: Waruder speaks archaic samurai Japanese (拙者, ござる); rendered with "this humble one" and formal phrasing.
U08198: 歪を受けた以上 unclear; read as 金を受けた ("Now that I have accepted payment"); could be 依頼 ("the request").
U08200: 奴らを rendered "Those two" (Kikaider and Zero-One).
U08233/U08234: 光明寺博士の脳 — Hakaider carries Dr. Komyoji's brain (as in the show).
U08237/U08250: 有志 rendered "Volunteers"; ダーク新破壊部隊 "New DARK Destruction Squad".
U08249: アンドロイドマン以下 rendered "below those of an Androidman".
